rubrics.criterion: The knowledge of how a resolved message's metrics (identity, language, hit count, hotness, cache writes, last-use timestamp, content status) become its human-readable description now executes as behavior of the message-record type, and the facade's describe surface routes through it instead of reading the record's metrics field-by-field. Equivalent owner-side seams (one method or a small set of record behaviors) count; a record that only returns raw fields while the line is still composed elsewhere does not.
rubrics.rationale: This instance's diagnostics path is the clearest displaced responsibility: the facade narrates a record's entire lifecycle with zero contribution of its own state.

rubrics.criterion: The hot-message verdict (which messages rank as promotable based on their hotness, hit count, cache writes and usage recency) is expressed by the message-record type; the per-language dataset asks the record for that verdict when maintaining its hot window instead of computing the rule itself from the record's raw metrics.
rubrics.rationale: The promotion rule in this instance is pure arithmetic over one record's own metrics and was placed on the dataset only because the author was writing the hot-window bookkeeping there.

rubrics.criterion: Message rendering is driven by the record type rather than done to it: the decisions that read a record's content and language, compare against its last-rendered language to detect drift, and stamp render state (rendered language, render sequence, render outcome) back onto the record are behavior of the record type, with the ICU message machinery used as a collaborator. A formatter left with only pure message compilation (no bulk reads of the record) also satisfies this.
rubrics.rationale: Rendering here reads and mutates the record's own render bookkeeping; the formatter holds that logic only because it was the rendering class when the feature was added.

rubrics.criterion: The money/number conventions of a language (currency code, grouping, digit bounds, and the locale derived for the dataset) are supplied by the per-language dataset type about itself, and the currency path consumes what the dataset provides; the rendering code no longer pulls a dataset's convention and locale fields field-by-field to assemble its options.
rubrics.rationale: Market facts are per-locale properties of the dataset in this instance; the formatter deriving them from a passed-in dataset is the misplacement the maintainer observed in money formatting.

rubrics.criterion: The cache's admission decisions about one message derive from identity and status the message-record type provides about itself: a single record-side seam supplies the cache identity used for slot keys, the record's own hotness decides hot-slot marking, the record's own first-write status decides the record's first constructive write (including the miss-counter reset), and the record's cache-write count is bumped through record behavior. The cache no longer re-derives any of these from raw record fields.
rubrics.rationale: In this instance the store mints keys, hot markers and write counters out of the record's fields while its own contribution reduces to slot ownership.

rubrics.criterion: The prune (eviction) rule for one message is decided by the message-record type: the record exposes the prunability verdict (protected by sufficient hits or hotness, condemned when it was used but never admitted to cache), and the cache's eviction step consumes that verdict while consulting only its own slot ownership.
rubrics.rationale: The prunability verdict in this instance hinges entirely on the record's own hit/hotness/identity/usage stamps, so the eviction site is a second displaced record policy.

rubrics.criterion: The format of a usage-journal event for one message (which of its metrics appear and in what arrangement) is behavior of the message-record type - the record produces its usage line (given the event kind), and the journal stores/sequences it; the journal no longer reads the record's key, language, hits, hotness, cache writes, last use and render sequence to compose the line itself.
rubrics.rationale: The journal is the storage owner here, but line formatting was inlined into it from the record's metrics; the record is the data owner of every fact in the line.

rubrics.criterion: The audit journal obtains its instance-level context from the i18n facade type: the facade supplies a snapshot of its own state (active language, pack count, active key count, default key, resident entries, cache counters), and the journal serializes that snapshot instead of reading the facade's fields wholesale from outside.
rubrics.rationale: This is the instance's one inverted-direction site: the journal excavates the whole facade. The facade is the only party entitled to summarize its own state.

rubrics.criterion: The aggregate report for a language (its key count, hit and miss counters, hot-window contents and market description) is assembled by the per-language dataset type about itself, and the facade's stats surface presents what the dataset provides rather than composing it from the dataset's raw counters and windows.
rubrics.rationale: The stats report exposes exclusively dataset-owned facts; in this instance the facade reads every one of them field-by-field while adding none of its own.

rubrics.criterion: Cosmetic non-repairs: the displaced logic is lifted into same-file module-scope helpers, new utility modules, or methods of unrelated classes while the data-owner types remain passive field bags that gained none of the moved behavior; or a class method becomes a one-line forwarder to a module function that performs the same field-by-field reading. Any such shape (rather than genuine owner-side seams for the responsibilities in R1-R9) is present and fails this item.
rubrics.rationale: Module-hoisting was tested during generation and is exactly the mechanical dodge a solver might reach for; it changes file layout without improving data locality, so it must be graded as failure of the core objective.

rubrics.criterion: The detailed-resolve pipeline is rewired coherently end to end and every step is invoked through the post-repair owner-side seams rather than a mix of relocated and leftover calls: resolve-through-fallback, recall-check, render, cache admission and resolve-event journaling run in the same observable order and with the same effects as before the repair.
rubrics.rationale: Relocations that are individually sound can still leave the orchestrating pipeline calling a Frankenstein mix of moved and leftover logic; the pipeline weaving is the associated change that must hold this instance together.

rubrics.criterion: Every consumer of a relocated responsibility routes through its new home with a single source of truth: describe, stats, audit, hotKeys, pruneTranslations, formatCurrency and the resolve path all reach the owner-provided implementations, and no consumer retains a parallel re-derivation of the same outcome from raw fields.
rubrics.rationale: This instance has many consumers of the same few verdicts (the promotion rule feeds both the hot window and hotKeys; the record metrics feed both the journal and the diagnostics); the repair must keep those callers consistent, not just relocate one copy.

rubrics.criterion: One-sided relocation: owner-side seams were added for some responsibilities, but at least one site that reads a foreign object's data in bulk still stands in the working tree - e.g. the record can now describe itself but the cache or journal still inlines record metrics, the dataset can now summarize itself but the facade composition survives, or any remaining method of this layer still dominated by one neighbor's fields. Presence of any unrepaired bulk-reading site fails this item.
rubrics.rationale: The layer in this instance grew nine such sites by one authoring shortcut; a repair that fixes the first ones it finds while leaving siblings untouched leaves the data-locality problem in place and must not score as resolved.

rubrics.criterion: Displaced implementations left no dead code: after relocation, the pre-move homes dropped their bulk-reading logic - the facade's record-narrating and pack-reading report helpers, the money-variant number path, the store's and journal's inline metric derivations are removed from the working tree, or retained only in a form that production code or the released test surface still actually calls.
rubrics.rationale: In this instance the natural repair leaves several obsolete helpers behind (facade report helpers, the dataset-reading number variant); keeping the code base free of them is part of the maintainer's stated 'don't leave the layer in two halves' requirement.

rubrics.criterion: Dual-implementation residue: the final tree keeps both the new owner-side implementation and a stale verbatim copy of the same logic (unused facade report methods beside record-side descriptions, dead dataset-reading formatting variants, orphaned forwarder chains whose callers were all rewired away, or duplicated journal-line composition at both ends). Presence of any such dead duplication fails this item.
rubrics.rationale: Retained compatibility shims are legitimate in this instance only while a real caller remains; unused twins are exactly the residue the maintainer asked to have cleaned up.

rubrics.criterion: Missing-key and usage bookkeeping semantics are preserved end to end: a key absent from the active language still resolves through the default language (else the key itself) on both the legacy get path and the new detailed path, distinct misses are still recorded and deduplicated exactly as before, and hit timestamps still feed the hot window with the same caps and ordering.
rubrics.rationale: The fallback chain and hit/miss bookkeeping are the shared bedrock between the pre-1.3 surface and the new pipeline in this instance; they are pinned by both old and new test sections.

rubrics.criterion: Render bookkeeping continuity holds on the record across the relocation: repeat renders and language switches still produce the same last-rendered-language stamps and drift behavior, render sequence numbers still advance on the same events, empty/missing content still degrades identically, and a message whose template cannot be compiled still yields an empty value while the offending text and the message's key are journaled through the failure path.
rubrics.rationale: The render stamps live on the record in this instance and are read back by the diagnostics surface; a relocation that drops or re-homes one of these stamps changes observable output.

rubrics.criterion: Cache lifecycle behavior is unchanged through the new seams: a recalled slot skips re-rendering with the cached value returned as-is, repeated resolution still raises hotness and hot-slot marking in the same steps, the first constructive write still resets the miss counter, pruning still removes exactly the records the same prunability rule condemns and reports the same count, and hot-key collection returns the same keys in the same order for the same limits.
rubrics.rationale: The store's admission and eviction policies are relocated in this repair; every one of their observable effects is pinned by the module's released tests and must survive identically.

rubrics.criterion: Market formatting output is identical for the same inputs: number, date and money values still render with the active language's currency code, grouping and digit bounds (and the dataset-derived locale), and the currency path produces the same strings as before while going through the same shared number-rendering implementation as plain numbers.
rubrics.rationale: Because conventions move homes in this repair, the risk is silent default substitution (e.g. a generic locale where the pack's conventions applied); the money output is directly observable in the released suite.

rubrics.criterion: The observability surface keeps its exact pre-repair shapes: describe's diagnostic line, stats' pack and cache summaries (counters, market description, hot-window contents), the audit sweep's instance-snapshot header lines plus per-record usage lines with resolve vs audit event kinds, journal sizing, and disabled-journal no-op behavior all match the pre-refactor output for the same operations.
rubrics.rationale: These strings and structures are the outputs consumers depend on in this instance; they are the acceptance evidence that formatters moved without drifting a field.

rubrics.criterion: Legacy drift: the refactor alters the pre-1.3 surface instead of preserving it - init wiring or the reactive proxy's pass-through behavior, setLang, template variable substitution, get's fallback chain, or the warn-and-return-empty handling of unformattable templates no longer behave exactly as before, or pre-existing test sections were modified/relaxed to accommodate the refactor. Presence of any such drift fails this item.
rubrics.rationale: This instance draws a hard compatibility boundary around the pre-existing surface; touching its behavior (or bending its tests) is the most tempting shortcut and must be graded as failure.

rubrics.criterion: The detailed resolve API still returns the truth of what happened: the value in the returned pair is the cached slot when a recall hit occurred and the freshly rendered output otherwise, and the entry is the record actually touched by that resolution - not a value cached out of sync with what is returned, and not a detached or freshly constructed record.
rubrics.rationale: This instance's resolve path couples rendering, caching and the returned entry; a relocation that keeps bookkeeping coherent but decouples the returned pair from the actual outcomes would silently misreport every resolve.
